nation  suffered  by  it :  when  it  came  to  be  generally
observed,  the  king  was  advised  to  issue  out  a  pro-

present  end  to  clipping.  But  Seimour,  being  then

the  circulation,  while  every  one  studied  to  put  out

priests :  he  was  naturally  a  man  of  truth,  fidelity,

times  were  not  acquainted :  so  it  was  necessary  to
know,  who  among  us  adhered  to  these  opinions :  the
present  government  was  begun  upon  a  comprehensive
foot,  it  being  hoped  that  all  parties  might  have  been
brought  to  concur  in  supporting  it ;.  but  the  effects
had  not  answered  expectation :  distinctions  had  been
made  between  a  king  de  jure  and  a  king  de  facto;
298  whereby  these  men plainly  declared,  with  whom
they  believed  the  right  was  lodged: this  opinion
must,  whensoever  that  right  comes  to  be  claimed,
oblige  those  who  hold  it  to  adhere  to  such  claimers :
it  seemed  therefore  in  some  sort  necessary,  that  the
